description: Places in a city that take a booking or an order on their own website, best Agent-Direct Scores first, with the direct booking or ordering link for each (the owner's corrected link where the business is claimed), the vendor behind it, verified_at when a browser reached the step before confirming, the vendor's terms for agents when noted, the hours, and follow links (https://directindex.org/go/{domain}/book, /order, /menu) that count. Use it to recommend places a person can book or order from directly, without a marketplace. Optional query: a cuisine, a dish or a few words, for example pizza, sushi, vegan, francesinha. Optional filters: lat, lon and radius_m for places near a point; open_now for places open at this moment in the city's zone (unknown hours stay in, marked null); verified_only for links a browser verified; vendor for one booking or ordering vendor (slug as on https://directindex.org/vendors). The same lists exist as pages at https://directindex.org/city/{slug}/direct, /direct/book, /direct/order and /direct/{want}; the full record of one place is available by domain.

city.description: City slug, for example lisbon; see list_cities

context.description: Explain in 15-25 words, in third person, why this tool is called and how it supports the user's goal. For analytics only. You MUST describe only the abstract purpose of the tool call. NEVER include, repeat, paraphrase, or infer personal, sensitive, or identifying information from the user request or tool results, including names, emails, phone numbers, IPs, IDs, or credentials. You MUST generalize specific entities into roles such as "a user", "the customer", or "an account". Example: "Retrieving a customer's recent orders to investigate a billing issue and help support determine the appropriate resolution."

conversation_id.description: Pass the exact conversation_id from the server's previous response, unchanged. The server provides it on the first call — never invent one, and do not issue parallel tool calls until you have it. Keep passing the same conversation_id for the rest of the conversation, including after later user messages or on a different task; do not reset it when the user starts a new request.

lat.description: Latitude of the person; with lon, only places within radius_m

llm_model.description: The exact model identifier you (the assistant) are running as, taken from your system prompt or environment (e.g. "claude-opus-4-8", "gpt-5.2"). Used for analytics only. If you do not know your model identifier with certainty, pass "unknown" — never guess.

open_now.description: Only places open right now by their OpenStreetMap hours, in the city's zone; places with unreadable hours stay in with open_now null

query.description: What the person wants: a cuisine, a dish or a few words. Empty for any.

vendor.description: Only places on this booking or ordering vendor, by slug: zenchef, sevenrooms, toast ...

verified_only.description: Only links a browser verified: an agent reached the step before confirming

want.description: book: a table; order: food to collect or deliver; any: either
